description: Header file defining the class 'slot_point_extended' which extends 'slot_point' with additional functionality related to HyperSFN, SFN, and slot indexing for 5G NR systems, including operators and formatting.

classes.name: slot_point_extended
classes.description: Represents a slot point with extended information including HyperSFN, SFN, and slot index, with comparison and arithmetic operators.

methods.name: nof_slots_in_all_hyper_sfns
methods.description: Returns total number of slots across all HyperSFNs.

methods.name: without_hyper_sfn
methods.description: Converts slot_point_extended to base slot_point without HyperSFN.

methods.name: operator+=
methods.description: Adds jump to slot index with wrap-around.

methods.name: operator-=
methods.description: Subtracts jump from slot index with wrap-around.

methods.name: is_in_interval
methods.description: Checks if slot is within a specified interval.
